args.sql:
SELECT
    mktdenom AS market_name,
    (market_status_reputation ->> 'status')::TEXT AS market_status,
    (market_status_reputation ->> 'trust_level')::TEXT AS market_trust_level,
    (market_status_reputation ->> 'reputation_score')::DECIMAL AS market_reputation_score,
    (market_status_reputation -> 'compliance_metrics' ->> 'rule_break_count')::INT AS rule_break_count,
    (market_status_reputation -> 'compliance_metrics' ->> 'warning_count')::INT AS warning_count,
    (market_status_reputation -> 'compliance_metrics' ->> 'penalty_count')::INT AS penalty_count,
    (market_status_reputation -> 'compliance_metrics' ->> 'restriction_level')::TEXT AS restriction_level,
    (market_status_reputation ->> 'community_trust_score')::DECIMAL AS community_trust_score,
    (market_status_reputation ->> 'dispute_resolution_score')::DECIMAL AS dispute_resolution_score
FROM markets
ORDER BY market_reputation_score DESC;

    (market_status_reputation -> 'compliance_metrics' ->> 'warning_count')::INT AS warning_count,
    (market_status_reputation -> 'compliance_metrics' ->> 'penalty_count')::INT AS penalty_count,
    (market_status_reputation -> 'compliance_metrics' ->> 'restriction_level')::TEXT AS restriction_level,
    (market_status_reputation ->> 'community_trust_score')::DECIMAL AS community_trust_score,
    (market_status_reputation ->> 'dispute_resolution_score')::DECIMAL AS dispute_resolution_score
FROM markets
ORDER BY market_reputation_score DESC;
